mapper.sql: PIXEL_CHAR_SN , MBR_SN , PET_SN , BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID
CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN , PET_SN , MBR_SN , OTO_INQRY_SN , CRT_JOB_STTS_CD , PRCS_BGNG_DT , PRCS_END_DT , FAIL_RSN , IDMPT_DMND_ID , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT
CHAR_PHOTO_SN , PIXEL_CHAR_SN , CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , PHOTO_ROLE_CD , SORT_SEQ , NOW_INDCT_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT
mapper.select: /* 반려동물별 픽셀 캐릭터 목록 조회 */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , R.BRUP_ROLE_CD , CASE WHEN R.RPRS_PET_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RPRS_PET_YN , C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN , J.CRT_JOB_STTS_CD , CASE WHEN C.PIXEL_CHAR_SN IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN C.BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN FROM BRUP_REL R JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = R.PET_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN PIXEL_CHAR C ON C.PET_SN = P.PET_SN AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN CHAR_CRT_JOB J ON J.CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN = (SELECT MAX(LJ.CHAR_CRT_JOB_SN) FROM CHAR_CRT_JOB LJ WHERE LJ.PET_SN = P.PET_SN) WHERE R.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.REG_DT , P.PET_SN
mapper.insert: /* 픽셀 캐릭터 등록 */ INSERT INTO PIXEL_CHAR ( MBR_SN , PET_SN , BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID ) VALUES ( #{mbrSn} , #{petSn} , 'N' , NOW() , NOW() , #{mdfrId} )
mapper.select: /* 캐릭터 보유 아이템 목록 조회 */ SELECT H.HLD_ITEM_SN , H.ITEM_SN , I.ITEM_NM , I.ITEM_REGN_CD , I.ATCH_FILE_SN , CASE WHEN H.EQUIP_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS EQUIP_YN FROM HLD_ITEM H JOIN ITEM I ON I.ITEM_SN = H.ITEM_SN WHERE H.PIXEL_CHAR_SN = #{pixelCharSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY I.ITEM_REGN_CD , I.SORT_SEQ , H.HLD_ITEM_SN
mapper.update: /* 보유 아이템 전체 착용 해제 */ UPDATE HLD_ITEM SET EQUIP_YN = 'N' , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE PIXEL_CHAR_SN = #{pixelCharSn} AND EQUIP_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: /* 캐릭터 생성용 반려동물 프로필 조회 */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , COALESCE(P.VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM, V.VRTY_NM) AS VRTY_NM , COALESCE(P.COLR_DRCT_INPT_NM, CC.COM_CD_NM) AS COLR_NM , P.CHRC_CN FROM PET P LEFT JOIN VRTY V ON V.VRTY_SN = P.VRTY_SN LEFT JOIN COM_CD CC ON CC.COM_CD = P.COLR_CD WHERE P.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'
